tips.contains: Text filters match anywhere in the value: qwerty finds qwerty@example.com, user@qwerty.example and user@mail.qwerty. Click the operator in a column filter to switch between contains, does not contain and is exactly.
tips.click: Click a value in the table to filter by it. <kbd>Alt</kbd>+click excludes it instead.
tips.combine: Different filters are combined with AND. Several statuses or servers are combined with OR.
tips.range: Pick a quick time range (1h, 24h, 7d, 30d) or set a custom one. “All” searches every stored message and can be slow.
tips.logs: The log lines search looks through every raw line. It is slow — narrow the time range first.
tips.drawer: Click a row to see the full message: envelope, recipients and the related log lines. Move between messages with <kbd>↑</kbd> <kbd>↓</kbd> (or <kbd>k</kbd> <kbd>j</kbd>), close with <kbd>Esc</kbd>.
tips.share: The address bar always mirrors the filters. Share copies a link with an absolute time range, so others see the same messages.
tips.export: Export writes the visible columns, in their order, to an Excel file — the current page or all matching messages.
tips.top: In Statistics, hide addresses from the top lists with the eye icon; the choice is kept in this browser.
